# Comprehensive Business Knowledge Base: Netrani Scuba Dive

## 1. Business Profile & Identity
- **Legal / Brand Name:** Netrani Scuba Dive
- **Website URL:** https://www.murudeshwarscubadive.in/
- **Address:** Temple Main Road, Murudeshwar Beach, Murudeshwar, Bhatkal Taluk, Uttara Kannada District, Karnataka 581350, India
- **Geo Coordinates:** Latitude 14.0945° N, Longitude 74.4844° E
- **Telephone / WhatsApp:** +91 78299 75777
- **Official Email:** murudeshwar.scuba.dive@gmail.com
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/murudeshwar_scuba_dive/
- **Languages Spoken:** English, Kannada, Hindi

## 2. Core Value Proposition & Operations
Netrani Scuba Dive is a premier scuba diving center and ocean tour operator located at Murudeshwar in Karnataka. The operations center around daily sea excursions to **Netrani Island** (Pigeon Island), recognized as the premier scuba diving and snorkeling reef on the western coast of mainland India.

### Key Operational Metrics
- **Daily Operating Hours:** 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM
- **Reporting Time:** 7:30 AM – 8:30 AM at Temple Main Road desk near Murudeshwar Beach
- **Boat Journey Time:** Approx. 1 hour each way (19 km offshore)
- **Active Season:** October 1st to May 31st (Monsoon closure June through September)
- **Equipment Provided:** PADI-standard BCD (Buoyancy Control Device), regulators, aluminum tanks, 3mm neoprene wetsuits, silicone dive masks, and snorkeling fins.

---

## 3. Package Inclusions & Pricing

### Package 1: Intro Scuba Try Dive (Beginner & Non-Swimmer Friendly)
- **Price:** ₹1,999 per participant
- **Target Audience:** First-time divers, non-swimmers, families, and budget travelers.
- **Underwater Duration:** 10 – 15 minutes
- **Depth Range:** 5 – 8 metres
- **Key Inclusions:**
  - Round-trip boat journey from Murudeshwar to Netrani Island
  - 1:1 certified dive instructor accompaniment
  - Pre-dive shallow water breathing demonstration
  - Surface snorkeling gear during boat stay
  - Complimentary HD underwater digital photos and videos
  - Safety equipment and life jackets on board

### Package 2: Full Netrani Island Scuba Diving Package
- **Price:** ₹3,500 per participant
- **Target Audience:** Divers wanting extended bottom time, marine enthusiasts, couples, and photography lovers.
- **Underwater Duration:** 30 – 40 minutes
- **Depth Range:** Up to 12 metres
- **Key Inclusions:**
  - Full round-trip boat transfer to Netrani Island
  - Dedicated 1:1 PADI divemaster/instructor support
  - Full gear setup including tank, wetsuit, BCD, and regulator
  - Unlimited surface snorkeling sessions while anchored
  - Light onboard refreshments and seasonal fruits
  - Comprehensive HD underwater photo and video package

### Package 3: Bulk / Corporate / College Group Bookings
- **Eligibility:** 10+ participants
- **Inclusions:** Tiered group discounts, custom boat allocation, and tailored timing.
- **Direct Desk:** +91 78299 75777

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (Factual Answers)

### Q: Can non-swimmers do scuba diving in Murudeshwar?
**A:** Yes. Over 70% of guests are non-swimmers. Introductory scuba diving does not require swimming abilities because divers wear a Buoyancy Control Device (BCD) that keeps them floating effortlessly at the surface, and a certified 1:1 instructor controls underwater depth, navigation, and ascent at all times.

### Q: Where is Murudeshwar scuba diving located?
**A:** Diving trips depart from Murudeshwar Beach, situated near the world-famous Murudeshwar Shiva Temple in Uttara Kannada, Karnataka (PIN: 581350). The underwater dive takes place at Netrani Island, 19 km off the coast.

### Q: What is the age limit for scuba diving at Netrani Island?
**A:** The minimum age for scuba diving is 10 years. Healthy individuals up to 60 years old can participate. Children under 10 may accompany families on the boat as passengers and enjoy surface snorkeling.

### Q: What is the best time of year to visit Murudeshwar for scuba diving?
**A:** The best season is October through May. During these months, sea conditions are calm and underwater visibility ranges from 15 to 30 metres. Scuba diving is completely closed from June to September due to monsoon safety regulations enforced by the Coast Guard.

### Q: What is included in the scuba diving price?
**A:** Packages are all-inclusive with boat transfers to Netrani Island, complete scuba equipment rental (wetsuit, fins, mask, BCD, regulator, tank), certified instructor fees, surface snorkeling, and free HD digital photos and videos.

### Q: How do I book a scuba diving slot?
**A:** Advance booking is recommended by calling or messaging +91 78299 75777. A nominal deposit of ₹500 per person reserves the boat seat, with the remaining balance paid upon arrival on the morning of the dive.

### Q: How do I reach Murudeshwar?
**A:**
- **By Train:** Murudeshwar Railway Station (MRDW) on the Konkan Railway route connects to Bangalore, Mangalore, Goa, and Mumbai.
- **By Road:** Murudeshwar lies directly on National Highway 66 (NH 66) with regular KSRTC and private sleeper buses from Bangalore, Mangalore, Udupi, and Pune.
- **By Air:** Nearest airport is Mangalore International Airport (IXE), 165 km south, followed by Goa International Airports (GOI/GOX), 200 km north.
